_comment: Example manifest for install-portable.ps1. Replace every sha256 with the real value from the vendor's release page before installing. An empty sha256 is refused unless -AllowUnverified is passed.

apps.name: Notepad++
apps.notes: Text / Markdown / code editing. Portable zip keeps settings inside its own folder.

apps.name: JPEGView
apps.notes: Fastest image viewer for large folders. Launching it with no argument opens its own NavPanel.png - that is normal.

apps.name: nomacs
apps.notes: Broadest format support, EXIF metadata, batch operations.

apps.name: ImageGlass
apps.notes: Modern UI. First run shows a Quick Setup wizard; it is portable, config stays in its folder.

apps.name: mpv
apps.notes: Best quality/format coverage. Keys: space, arrows, f fullscreen, 9/0 volume, q quit. Subtitles auto-load from a same-named .srt.

apps.name: MPC-BE
apps.notes: Familiar player UX: playlist, speed (Ctrl+up/down), subtitles (Ctrl+L).

apps.name: rclone
apps.notes: Sync/backup to a NAS over SMB or WebDAV. `rclone mount` needs WinFsp, which DOES require elevation - use OS drive mapping for that instead.
